title: Continuous unit orientation of a C¹ graph and the Jacobian identity for n-covectors
statement: Let n ≥ 1, k ≥ 0, ι : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+k} and ι' : ℝ^k → ℝ^{n+k} linear isometries with ⟨ιv, ι'w⟩ = 0 for all v, w, s > 0, z ∈ ℝ^{n+k}, u : ℝⁿ → ℝ^k of class C¹ on the open ball D = B_s(0), Φ(v) := z + ιv + ι'u(v), Σ := Φ(D), b(v) := (DΦ(v)e₁, …, DΦ(v)eₙ) with DΦ(v) = fderiv ℝ Φ v, and J(v) := √det(DΦ(v)*∘DΦ(v)) (DΦ(v)* the adjoint). Then there exist ξ : ℝ^{n+k} → Λₙ(ℝ^{n+k}) (the contract's MultiVector (n+k) n, continuous linear functionals on n-covectors) and β : ℝ^{n+k} → Λⁿ(ℝ^{n+k}) (n-covectors), both continuous on Σ, such that (a) ξ(x)(β(x)) = 1 for every x ∈ Σ; (b) for every v ∈ D, ξ(Φ(v)) is a unit orientation of the subspace range DΦ(v) (IsUnitOrientationOf); (c) for every v ∈ D and every n-covector α, α(b(v)) = J(v)·ξ(Φ(v))(α).
lean_statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (u : Euclid n → Euclid k) (z : Euclid (n + k)) (s : ℝ), 0 < n → (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → 0 < s → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u (ball 0 s) → ∃ (ξ : Euclid (n + k) → MultiVector (n + k) n) (β : Euclid (n + k) → Covector (Euclid (n + k)) n), ContinuousOn ξ ((fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) '' ball (0 : Euclid n) s) ∧ ContinuousOn β ((fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) '' ball (0 : Euclid n) s) ∧ (∀ x ∈ (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) '' ball (0 : Euclid n) s, ξ x (β x) = 1) ∧ (∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) s, IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ (z + ι v + ι' (u v))) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) v : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)))) ∧ ∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) s, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid (n + k)) n, α (fun i => fderiv ℝ (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) v (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) = Real.sqrt (((fderiv ℝ (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) v).adjoint ∘L fderiv ℝ (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) v).det) * ξ (z + ι v + ι' (u v)) α
